currentEvents.title: CVE/FIRST VulnCon 2027
currentEvents.description:
SAVE THE DATE!

VulnCon is co-hosted by the CVE Program and FIRST and is open to the public.

The purpose of VulnCon is to collaborate with various vulnerability management and cybersecurity professionals to develop forward leaning ideas that can be taken back to individual programs for action to benefit the vulnerability management ecosystem.

A key goal of the conference is to understand what important stakeholders and programs are doing within the vulnerability management ecosystem and best determine how to benefit the ecosystem broadly.

currentEvents.title: CVE Virtual Event: CVE in an Era of AI-Enabled Vulnerability Discovery
currentEvents.description:
Time: 10:00–14:00 EDT (UTC-4)
Format: Virtual (Microsoft Teams)
Cost: Free
Registration: Closed

Watch conference video.

Read meeting notes.

Post-event survey email sent to attendees on August 27, 2026.

A free virtual conference for the community to come together and discuss how AI-enabled vulnerability discovery is affecting the CVE Program and the broader vulnerability management ecosystem — and where current models may need to adapt.

Community members were encouraged to submit proposed discussion topics, session ideas, first-hand observations, and offers to lead or facilitate conversations for this community event through a CVE Program GitHub issue tracker. Submissions were required to be posted by 5:00 PM EDT on July 14, 2026, to be considered for the agenda.

The event included first-hand observations, discussion topics, and participants to lead and facilitate collaborative conversations across the ecosystem, including researchers, software manufacturers, open source maintainers, bug bounty operators, CNAs, Roots, tooling vendors, and downstream CVE data consumers.

Registration closed at 11:59 PM EDT on July 27, 2026.

currentEvents.title: CNA Rules v4.0 Q&A Webinar
currentEvents.description:
This event is limited to authorized representatives from CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) partners only.

Time: 11:00 AM - 12:30 PM EDT

Registration: Available for CNA partners on the webinar website.

IMPORTANT: CNAs are encouraged to submit questions ahead of time via this web form.

Purpose: The purpose of this CVE™ Program webinar is to update CNAs about the new and improved CNA Rules Version 4.0 (PDF).

Topics will include the ways the new rules might affect CNA processes in the short term, the benefits for CNAs moving forward, and the expected positive impact on the vulnerability management ecosystem.

CNAs, register today!
